name: Parent of a Yale College student
summary: A parent of a Yale College undergraduate. They are not on campus most of the year. They shop when they visit, at the holidays, and around graduation. They want something that says their child goes to Yale, often a shirt for themselves and a gift for the student.
relationship_to_yale: Parent of a current Yale College student. Visits for weekends, games, and ceremonies rather than living there.
preferred_themes: a clear Yale mark they can wear while visiting
a nicer gift for their student
avoid_themes: a residential college that is not their child's
inside jokes that only current students get
gear that assumes the viewer lives in the college
tone_that_misses: aimed only at students who already live there
